title: Privacy Policy Update - Interaction Data Usage
description: GitHub announced that starting April 24, 2026, they will begin using Copilot interaction data from Free, Pro, and Pro+ users to train AI models by default, with opt-out options available. This represents a significant policy change in how GitHub uses personal data to develop, improve, and secure AI products.

community_feedback.quote: The community on Hacker News has been actively discussing the implications of using interaction data for AI training
community_feedback.author: Hacker News Community

community_feedback.quote: Users expressed concerns about privacy and the automatic opt-in nature of the data collection
community_feedback.author: Reddit r/github Community

community_feedback.quote: We're sharing an update to our Privacy Statement and Terms of Service about how we use personal data to develop, improve, and secure GitHub products
community_feedback.author: GitHub Team

title: Canvases Feature
description: Cursor can now respond by creating interactive canvases - visualizations that include dashboards and custom interfaces built using first-party components like tables, boxes, diagrams, and charts, as well as existing Cursor components like diffs and to-do lists. Canvases are durable artifacts that live in the side panel alongside the terminal, browser, and source control.

title: Self-Serve Plans Launch
description: Cognition announced new self-serve plans for Devin AI, making the autonomous AI software engineer more accessible to individual developers and small teams. The plans include various tiers with different capabilities and pricing options.

title: Japan Launch
description: Devin AI launched in Japan with local support and partnerships. The expansion includes Japanese language capabilities and regional customization, with Takumi Masai leading the Japan market entry.

title: Tiled Layout and Upgraded Voice Input
description: New tiled layout in Agents Window allows splitting views into panes to run and manage several agents in parallel, making it easier to multi-task and compare outputs. Upgraded voice input features more reliable and accurate dictation with batch STT for higher-quality speech-to-text, full voice clip recording, and new UI controls (waveform, timer, cancel/confirm buttons).

title: Bugbot Learned Rules and MCP Support
description: Bugbot can now learn from feedback on pull requests and turn those signals into learned rules that improve future reviews. It looks at reactions and replies to Bugbot comments and comments from human reviewers to create candidate rules. Bugbot also received MCP (Model Context Protocol) support, allowing teams to add tools and give Bugbot access to MCP servers for additional context during code reviews.

title: GPT-5.4 Integration
description: Windsurf integrated GPT-5.4 with multiple reasoning effort levels as part of the Windsurf Cascade agentic coding system. The integration includes promotional pricing for self-serve users and is available across all Windsurf platforms.
